label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Mrs. Renee, this is Thu, the owner of Lotus Garden. First, I'm sorry your toe hurt and that you had to go to urgent care. I really mean that. You've been coming to us for two years, and I don't want to fight with you here.

But a lot of people are reading this now, so I want to say calmly what happened from our side.

You came in Saturday, October 24 for the deluxe pedicure. Your tech was Vy, my niece. She has been licensed for three years. She was born here in Houston and she speaks English. She's just shy and doesn't talk much, so it wasn't fair to say she barely speaks it.

Vy remembers that during the pedicure you asked her to cut the cuticle back more because you like it very clean. She told you she didn't want to take too much, and you said it was fine, you always have it done that way. I'm not saying this to blame you. I'm saying it because she did hear you and she did understand you.

You came back on November 2 and showed me the toe. I offered you the full $45 back, and I also offered to pay your urgent care copay if you bring me the receipt. I'm sorry if it felt like I shrugged at you. That's not how I meant it. You asked for $300 cash and free pedicures for a year, and I said no to that. But I did not say no to helping you.

That offer is still open today: the $45 refund and your urgent care copay. Just bring the receipt.

For everyone else reading, this is how we clean:

- Every metal tool goes through the autoclave and comes out in a sealed pouch. We open the pouch in front of you.
- Files and buffers are new for each person, and you take them home.
- The tub gets a new plastic liner every single time.
- We passed our state inspection this August with no violations. The paper is on the wall, and anyone can come look at it.

You said you filed with the state. That's your right, and I have no problem with it. The inspector is welcome any day.

To the comment that these places are all dirty: I understand why people worry, but that one hurt the most, like we are all the same. I opened this salon in 2007, after years of working for my aunt. That's 19 years, and in all that time I have never had one infection complaint. I work very hard to keep it that way.

@MarisolB, thank you for saying what you've seen in four years of coming to us. It meant a lot to me, and to Vy too. She read this thread and she is taking it very hard.

Mrs. Renee, please call me at the salon or come in and talk to me. I would much rather sit down with you than go back and forth here. I'm there every day.

Thu
Lotus Garden Nails

---

I didn't put in a phone number since I don't have it, so add it after "call me at the salon" if you want it there. I also kept the part about Vy to one line and left out that she wants to quit, so it doesn't read like blaming Renee.
